Home » AAPL climbs to new high on Berkshire news, Cook ‘thrilled’ Warren Buffett is major investor AAPL climbs to new high on Berkshire news, Cook ‘thrilled’ Warren Buffett is major investor 4 May 2018 Anon
After nuking fears that the iPhone X may be a colossal failure somehow, Apple’s stock price has been on a climb this week with AAPL touching a new high during intraday trading. As CNBC notes, investors responded positively to Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway firm upping its investment in Apple by 75 million shares last quarter.
